verdict.reason: The source is the 2026 DBIR (22,000+ breaches), not the 2025 DBIR the claim cites. It gives no 12,195 breach count, no 54% edge-device remediation figure, and no 32-day edge-device median; the 32 days is last year's KEV median. It says exploitation was 20% last year, but that is a different edition, and 9% is the long-tail share of open KEV vulnerabilities, not 'all scanned vulnerabilities'.
